verified.name: Engine Ventures
verified.thesis: Engine Ventures invests in early-stage Tough Tech companies developing hardware-based technologies across deep tech fields including biotech, robotics, green energy, agriculture, manufacturing, material science, and quantum computing.
verified.notes: Engine Ventures separated from The Engine (nonprofit incubator/accelerator) in 2023 as a standalone venture capital firm. The Engine was founded by MIT in 2016. Per Wikipedia: 'In 2023, the investment fund separated from The Engine and rebranded as the venture capital firm Engine Ventures.' Per source [1]: 'In 2023, Engine Ventures spun out as a separate investment firm focused on Tough Tech companies.' Current senior partners/leadership of Engine Ventures not explicitly identified in sources provided. The Engine (nonprofit) maintains separate leadership including Emily Knight (CEO & President). No specific AUM or flagship fund name found for Engine Ventures in provided sources.
